Take the money to Casino Belmonte.

Then we'll have to knock on the door.
Quiero ese sobre. Consigue un coche rápi: I want that envelope. Get a fast car, catch up to it and stop it any way you can. Ram it or shoot it, but it must not reach the police station.

Pick up the loot from the safe.

Pick up the box of rifles.

Your aunt Encarna is waiting for you at La Gaviota Bar.

Tía, ¿desde cuándo planeas atracos?: Auntie, since when do you plan robberies?
Tú conduce y no preguntes. Y con cuidado: You drive and don't ask questions. And carefully, the product is delicate.
Tú eres Dani. Encarna dice que eres de f: So you're Dani. Encarna says you can be trusted. I say we'll see.
A warning visible from all over the bay. You gain street reputation, and Los Calaveras won't forgive you.

Un cliente del Chispas quiere un deporti: A customer of El Chispas wants one very specific sports car.

Una vez juntos, en ese mismo menú ves qu: Once you're together, in that same menu you can see who's there and where. Press Enter on a friend to set them on the GPS or send them money. You can also write each other messages.
Unos matones molestan al proveedor de En: Some thugs are bothering Encarna's supplier at the fish market.

Ve a Ultramarinos Paco, en la Avenida de: Go to Paco's Grocery Store, on Avenida del Faro.
Ve a la Fábrica abandonada y elimina a l: Go to the Abandoned Factory and take out the six Calaveras.

Go to Club Neón and pick up the envelope.

Ve al Restaurante Sibarita, en La Colina: Go to Sibarita Restaurant, in La Colina, and pick up the envelope.
Go to the Alameda Park Pond.
Go back to La Gaviota Bar.
Y en esta oficina de empleo, y en las ac: And at this job center, and at the academies, there's the honest life: steady jobs with schedules and courses to get promoted. It's all on the phone too, with M.
And you want me to steal a police car. From the door of the police station.
Y si no quieres conducir, pulsa la Y: es: And if you don't want to drive, press Y: it's the GPS autopilot. With a destination set, the car accelerates, brakes, turns, waits at traffic lights and stops when it arrives.

So you're Encarna's nephew. Or niece. I can't hear a thing with this noise.
¡Corre al Bar La Gaviota y acaba con los: Run to La Gaviota Bar and take out the five hitmen before it's too late!

¡Dani! Acaba de salir con su Platino bli: Dani! He just left in his armored Platino. If he reaches the midnight ferry, we'll never see him again. Step on it!

We got it! Two years of conversations. Varela is finished... if we survive to publish it.
¡Ni un arañazo! Bueno, casi. Tienes futu: Not a scratch! Well, almost. You have a future. When you want to earn some money, bring me cars at the scrapyard next door: they pay by model and condition.

¡Virgen del Carmen, cuánto billete! Con: Holy Virgen del Carmen, so much cash! With this I'll fix the roof and still have enough to treat the whole neighborhood.
¿Tú eres Dani? Marta me dijo que podía f: You're Dani? Marta told me I could trust you. Here, this memory stick has Belmonte's entire accounting.
¿Y quieres que entre yo sol[o|a] ahí?: And you want me to go in there alone?
